# Godot editor icons (subset)

SVG icons from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/tree/master/editor/icons
at commit 67421f36e5069e62573c44beb8dd2f8f91e065b0. MIT License - see LICENSE.txt.

Rendered to 40 px PNGs in Content/Editor/MaterialEditor/Icons (Luma name <- Godot icon):

- Apply.png <- (UE4 icon_MatEd_Apply_40x, see below)
- Save.png <- Save.svg
- Browse.png <- Filesystem.svg
- Home.png <- CenterView.svg
- Palette.png <- ListSelect.svg
- LiveUpdate.png <- AutoPlay.svg
- Sphere.png <- SphereMesh.svg
- Cube.png <- BoxMesh.svg
- Plane.png <- PlaneMesh.svg
- Cylinder.png <- CylinderMesh.svg
- Mesh.png <- MeshInstance3D.svg
- Reset.png <- Reload.svg
- Search.png <- Search.svg

Exception: Apply/Sphere/Cube/Plane/Cylinder/Mesh.png (the preview primitives) are the full-colour
icon_MatEd_*_40x icons from ThirdParty/icons (UE4 editor pack), not Godot icons.
- Details.png <- Edit.svg (rotated 25 degrees clockwise)
- Stats.png <- Performance.svg
